notes: 22 paragraph-level historical claim references with direct URLs, source passage locators, access scopes and limitations. UN Charter texts and conventions are identified as legal documents rather than evidence of compliance. The 1945 Security Council had 11 members; modern UN voting pages describe the expanded council, so only enduring veto structure is attributed to 1945. The UDHR is a declaration, not an individually ratified treaty. The original 1951 Refugee Convention has a mandatory pre-1951 time limit and an optional European geographic limitation, addressed by the 1967 Protocol. Bretton Woods participation is not equated with political independence or equal power. No duration target.
